statement: A robot stands in the top-left cell of a grid with rows rows and cols columns. It wants to reach the bottom-right cell.
At each move the robot goes one cell right or one cell down.
Return the number of different paths from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell.

examples.explanation: Every path makes 2 down moves and 2 right moves, and there are 6 ways to order those 4 moves.
Every path makes 3 down moves and 2 right moves. Choosing where the 2 right moves go among 5 gives 10 paths.
